i.norm: Tests for Tag semantics: layout classification (inline vs block) and case-insensitive tag lookup.

Verifies that HTML tag lookup is case-insensitive regardless of the JVM default locale. The {@code htmlDefault} ParseSettings normalises tag names to lowercase, so "SCRIPT" and "script" must resolve to the same Tag. The locale guard catches the classic Turkish-locale pitfall where {@code "SCRIPT".toLowerCase()} yields {@code "scrıpt"} (dotless-i).
Static valueOf: equal by value (not necessarily the same instance)
TagSet.valueOf: returns cached instances, so both lookups must be the exact same object
